title: Esse Est Percipi (Rendered on Sight)
summary: A gallery of 100 paintings where the browser refuses to render the ones you are not looking at, minting each from chance on sight and forgetting it on leaving.
mechanism: CSS content-visibility:auto (Containment L2) skips layout/paint for off-viewport panels; contentvisibilityautostatechange mints a per-perception crypto-random canvas and ceases it when unperceived; a live census counts what exists.
references: George Berkeley, A Treatise Concerning the Principles of Human Knowledge (1710)
Ronald Knox, the 'tree in the quad' limerick
